case_analysis.thread_summary: This thread (January 28 - February 17, 2025) covers the final stages of a Bluetooth SIG proxy registration for [COMPANY] (Premium Audio Company Technology Center, contact [PERSON]/Yoneda) for an ONKYO GX10 Powered Speaker, referencing two component QDIDs. After receiving the signed proxy registration confirmation form and remittance confirmation, [PERSON]/Sakai advances the registration to the review page, shares a screenshot for customer sign-off, then performs final confirmation and shares the My Page URL for the customer to view registration details pre-publication. Sakai then requests Compliance Folder materials (Bluetooth operation manual section, block diagram, outline drawings, antenna radiation-gain data) from the customer, compiles them onto a CD-R, ships it via trackable mail, and explains retention rules (1 year post-discontinuation, audit-only presentation) and free derivative-model registration via 'Manage Submitted Products'. The customer confirms receipt and retention understanding, closing out the engagement.
all_questions_found: Can the customer review the registration's review page before it is finalized, and once finalized, can they view the registration details before the public release date?
What product materials (beyond registration-process documents) are needed for the Compliance Folder, and how will the completed Compliance Folder be delivered to the customer?
How long must the customer retain the Compliance Folder, and under what circumstances must it be presented?
If the customer later releases additional models using the same Bluetooth module and host stack, do those need a new registration?
case_analysis.key_technical_discussion: The registration referenced two component QDIDs for a Powered Speaker logo certification. Before finalizing, the consultant shared a review-page screenshot for customer sign-off; after finalization, the customer's account holders could view the registration via My Page even pre-publication. The Compliance Folder was assembled from registration-process documents plus customer-supplied materials (Bluetooth-section operation manual, block diagram, outline drawings, and 2.4 GHz inverted-F antenna radiation-gain data) and physically shipped on CD-R via Japan Post Click Post with a tracking number. Retention runs 1 year from discontinuation of sales of the Product List models, with presentation required only upon an SIG audit request (likened to a car's vehicle inspection certificate). Future derivative models sharing the same module/host stack can be added to the Product List for free via 'Manage Submitted Products' on My Page.
case_analysis.key_decision_logic: The registration process followed a confirm-before-finalize pattern: review page shared for sign-off, then final confirmation, then My Page access shared for ongoing visibility. Compliance Folder compilation and delivery were gated on receiving all required customer-supplied materials, with delivery via trackable physical mail. Retention and audit guidance were proactively communicated, along with the free derivative-model registration path, to set expectations for future product expansions without implying unnecessary re-registration costs.
case_analysis.risk_if_done_wrong: Finalizing a proxy registration without customer sign-off on the review page risks uncaught errors going live. Failing to deliver or properly explain Compliance Folder retention could leave the customer unprepared for an SIG audit. Not informing the customer about free derivative-model registration could lead them to pay for unnecessary full re-registrations for future models sharing the same module/host stack.
case_analysis.consulting_takeaway: For proxy registrations: always share a review-page screenshot for customer sign-off before final confirmation, then provide the My Page URL for ongoing visibility. After finalization, proactively collect and compile Compliance Folder materials, deliver them via trackable mail, and clearly explain the 1-year post-discontinuation retention rule (audit-only presentation) alongside the free derivative-model registration path via 'Manage Submitted Products' for future models sharing the same module/host stack.
